description: Long-running daemon. Every 60s, queries six counts: mcp_server_registry, mcp_attestations, mcp_signal_scores, mcp_decisions, mcp_fingerprints, mcp_discovery_candidates (separated by promoted=TRUE vs FALSE). Computes progress percentages against target_total of 20000. POSTs to /write table='service_health' with service='goal_progress', last_heartbeat=now, payload structured as JSON in metadata field if schema supports it OR write to a separate mesh_events row with event_type='goal_progress_snapshot'. Heartbeat is the row write itself. Lockfile. This is the single-row truth source for how close ZO-Sentinel is to v1.0 readiness. Render-friendly format.
